basicInfo.name: Aris
basicInfo.flavor: As one of the five members of the Pentagon, she is consistently active on the front lines. The more she draws upon the earth dragon's power, the more yellow smoke seeps from her body, earning her battlefield moniker of \"Earthen Aura.\

Normal Attack.desc:
Single Enemy
 - Deals damage equal to 60% of Physical Attack plus 70% of target's Defense 1 time(s).
 - 40% chance to inflict Stun. [Duration: 1 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 60% of Physical Attack.
 - Increases Damage: To 70% of Magic Attack.

Skill 1.desc:
Single Enemy
 - Deals damage equal to 62% of Physical Attack and Piercing damage equal to 71% of target's Defense 5 time(s).
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 62% of Physical Attack.
 - Increases Damage: To 71% of Magic Attack.
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Activates again up to 1 time(s) with 100% power upon defeating an enemy with this skill.

Skill 2.desc:
All Enemies
 - Deals damage equal to 45% of Physical Attack plus 50% of target's Defense 2 time(s).
 - 45% chance to inflict Stun. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 45% of Physical Attack.
 - Increases Damage: To 50% of Magic Attack.

Passive.desc:
Self
 - Revives with 100% HP upon falling in battle. [Once per Battle]
 - Grants 1 stack(s) of Earth Dragon's Fury upon being hit by an enemy's attack 1 time(s). [Max 30 Stack(s)]
 - Getting attacked by an enemy 1 time(s) increases Awakening Gauge Boost to 3.
 - Grants 10 stack(s) of Earth Dragon's Fury upon revival. [Max 30 Stack(s)]
 - All Allies
 - Grants Block Rate Boost. [Always Active]
 - Front Row Allies
 - Grants a Barrier equal to 52% of the caster's Physical Attack upon using a skill 1 time(s). [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Increases Effect: Earth Dragon's Fury\nGrants 1 stack of 6% Damage Dealt Boost. [Max 30 Stacks]\nGrants 1 stack of 6% Physical Attack Boost. [Max 30 Stacks]

profile.dislikes: The color ocher, the majority of men.
